instruction: Set VS Code to reformat files each time you save.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to modify VS Code settings to enable format-on-save feature. The evaluator uses existing check_json_settings function to verify that settings.json contains 'editor.formatOnSave': true. This is a simple settings modification task similar to the original.
metadata.verification: The check_json_settings metric verifies that the settings.json file contains the expected key-value pair for format-on-save setting.
